patch_description:
The validation failure was caused by correctness problems rather than the printed dataframe diagnostics. The previous implementation could overwrite rows using `as_completed`, fabricate and later remove an `original_index` column, merge columns, lose row-specific column orderings by returning `[]`, and reorder values without reliably preserving their source row identity. It also optimized squared cell lengths and adjacent grouping rather than the evaluator's serialized character-prefix objective.

This replacement preserves every input cell, row, column, and index. It builds a small bounded set of column-order candidates, scores each candidate using exact sorted serialized-row LCP reuse, selects the best candidate, and returns valid per-row column orderings. It supports merged-column contiguity and one-way dependency precedence without changing stored values.
